children.value: > Fact From Story The Blackhawks rallied from a 2-0 deficit, scoring four unanswered goals to pick up the victory in Pittsburgh.
> > Fact From Story The Blackhawks scored four unanswered goals.
> > > Fact From Story Bryan Rust opened the scoring for the Penguins in the first period, and a Sidney Crosby goal in the second doubled the Pittsburgh lead.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A 2-0 deficit means that the other team scored 2 goals.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Scoring goals results in a higher score.
> Commonsense Knowledge If a team scores more goals than the other team, they win.
